name: You know my name?
source:
A short story about a girl who has forgotten her name.
But it seems she lost something else along with her name. And she's losing it even now.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3056420/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个关于一个忘记自己名字的女孩的短篇故事。
但她似乎除了名字之外还失去了其他东西。即使现在她也正在失去它。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3056420/]Steam[/url]]
